issue_context.title: Reduce code duplication in test/e2e/storage/testsuites/snapshottable.go
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

The changes to support snapshot tests for Generic Ephemeral Volumes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105659 generated some duplicated code in the file `test/e2e/storage/testsuites/snapshottable.go` as commented here: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105659#discussion_r732587703, it'd be great to create functions that are reused in both `(ephemeral)` and `(persistent)` tests.

Things that are needed:

- A kubernetes dev cluster (I follow [this guide](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/cluster/gce/windows/README-GCE-Windows-kube-up.md) to create a GCE cluster)
- Knowledge about how to [run e2e tests](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-testing/e2e-tests.md)

/sig storage
/area testing
/good-first-issue

### Why is this needed?

Improve readability of the storage VolumeSnapshot tests

hey @yuvaldolev, sorry for the late response and thanks for the reminder, I always run my tests with `hack/ginkgo.sh` and with a GCE cluster (not a kind cluster) for example following [this guide](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-testing/e2e-tests.md#debugging-an-e2e-test-with-a-debugger-delve).

The VolumeSnapshot feature requires a CSI Driver, in our e2e tests we use a CSI Driver that's embedded in the kubernetes codebase called csi-hostpath, from the logs I saw that it used csi-hostpath which I think it's ok, ideally we should test it with a real CSI Driver like PD CSI Driver but that's going to provision storage in GCP.
